text: RESOLVED IN CODE, and instrumented better than requested. .compose_frame_metric propagates the retained inverse as inverse$value * tcrossprod(1/sqrt(w)) = D(1/sqrt w) Sigma D(1/sqrt w). Verified: it is the true inverse of the composed metric (max|K_eff inv - I| = 4.4e-16) and matches the closed form to 1.8e-15. metric_components reports inverse_quadratic_mode = retained_inverse_metric with factorization_count = 0. Supplying the same metric WITHOUT a retained inverse falls back to cholesky_solve with factorization_count = 1 and an identical K_coh, so the cost is observable rather than merely avoided. Recommend closing.
